_comment: Every task ID. Each task is defined on the BuddhistAI knowledge base (https://buddhistai.github.io/knowledge-base/tasks/<id>.html). Skills in BuddhistAI/buddhist-skills are named <task-id>-<language>. Status: active (has TASK.md, scorer, and at least one data set) or planned.

tasks.title: Table-of-contents extraction
tasks.summary: List the titles, levels, and locations of a text's sections.

tasks.title: Text cleanup
tasks.summary: Fix OCR and input errors and normalize a text without changing its content.

tasks.title: Segmentation
tasks.summary: Split a text into sentences or translation units.

tasks.title: Entity extraction
tasks.summary: Find people, places, texts, and other named entities.

tasks.title: Citation mapping
tasks.summary: Find quotations and references and link them to their source texts.

tasks.title: Text-translation alignment
tasks.summary: Align a source text with its translation, segment by segment.

tasks.title: Text-commentary alignment
tasks.summary: Link each root text passage to the commentary passages that explain it.

tasks.title: Term extraction
tasks.summary: Propose glossary terms and their renderings from a source text and translation.

tasks.title: Translation
tasks.summary: Produce a draft translation. First set in preparation: Tibetan colophons into French, scored by meaning units.

tasks.title: Translation review
tasks.summary: Check a translation against its source, the glossary, and the style guide.

tasks.title: OCR
tasks.summary: Turn an image of a page into Unicode text. Tibetan is ranked on BDRC's external leaderboard.

tasks.title: Spell check
tasks.summary: Flag and correct misspelled words in a source text or a translation.

tasks.title: Edition collation
tasks.summary: Compare editions of a text and record where and how they differ.

tasks.title: Block ID assignment
tasks.summary: Give every block of a text (paragraph, verse, section) a stable ID.

tasks.title: Annotation detection
tasks.summary: Find interlinear notes, glosses and other annotations and separate them from the main text.
